images.observation: Audio settings display the failed-request message and explicitly state that the previous track is retained. Retry, music/SFX volume controls and the lower status area fit within the current window; no overlapping or clipped controls were visible.
After retry, the failure message and retry action remain visible rather than reporting readiness. The audio settings layout remains stable with legible controls and no visible overlap.
The recovered state displays music ready and removes the retry action. The following SFX controls move upward cleanly, with no stale failure text, duplicated controls or clipped labels visible.

The two same-name swift-arrow stacks remain visibly separate, labelled x3 and x2. Card faces, names, costs and descriptions are legible; the warehouse title, filters, resources and navigation fit the window, with no stale modal over the cards.
nonBlockingNotes: The small warehouse summary on the bright left background has weaker contrast; its text remains distinguishable in this image.

images.observation: The returned base page shows its title/resources, base tasks, preparation panel and navigation without leftover warehouse cards, conversion confirmation or detail masks. The pending-2 row and collection badge 2 are both visible and do not overlap.

The photo-studio title, total 291, nine category counts and search/filter controls are visible without overlap. The first row of four photos and the selected photo side panel are legible and contained; clipping of the second row at the scroll-viewport bottom is consistent with the visible scroll region.

The centered import confirmation fully displays target slot 5, source slot 5, saved timestamp, replacement warning, return and confirm buttons. Background JSON and slot pages are dimmed; no old notice or global HUD covers the dialog.
